Notes, News & Nonsense405

TV Teletype

SNL — A Saturday Night Live Thanksgiving airs Friday at 8 on CKPR — the real Saturday show is off, so 11:29 is a repeat.

9:02 — Georgie & Mandy starts at 9:02 on Wednesday. Not 9:00. Not 9:05. 9:02. Somebody owns a precise watch.

CITY HALL — The Minutes — Thunder Bay council in podcast form — runs Saturday mornings on CKPR at 9. City hall before the cartoons.

THE HOBO — The Littlest Hobo walks again Sunday at 8:30 — “The Three Monkeys of Bah Roghar.” The dog is still working.

FOOTBALL — Thanksgiving week: Chiefs–Bills Thursday, Broncos–Steelers Friday at 3, Patriots–Chargers Sunday. The turkey is optional.

BAKE-OFF — The Pillsbury Bake-off runs two hours Monday at 8 and pushes FBI clean off the night. The agents are presumably baking.

TWICE — The Floor — “The Second Coming” — airs Wednesday on CKPR and Thursday on FOX. Same episode twice.
